style_rules: Warm low Moroccan sunlight, honey sandstone, carved Atlas cedar with fine vertical fluting, thin polished brass rings, deep amber glass for oils, sand-white opaque glass for emulsions, no printed labels or text on packaging, real skin texture, no real people.

anchor.prompt: Luxury editorial product photograph for a Moroccan argan-oil beauty house. Five skincare products with one unified design language stand together on a block of honey-coloured Souss sandstone: a 30 ml cylindrical dropper bottle, a squat 50 ml cream jar, a 50 ml airless pump bottle, a tall slim 100 ml hair-oil bottle and a tiny 15 ml precious-oil vial. The dropper bottle, jar, hair-oil bottle and vial are thick deep translucent amber glass with softly rounded shoulders; the pump bottle is opaque matte sand-white glass. Every closure is pale Atlas cedar wood carved with fine vertical fluting and finished with one thin polished brass ring. No printed labels, no text, no logos on any product, only a tiny debossed circle-and-horizon emblem low on each glass. Fresh argan branches with small leaves and green-yellow argan fruit lie around the base, a few cracked argan kernels and one glossy drop of golden oil on the stone. Low warm morning sunlight from the left, long soft shadows, the patterned shadow of a carved Moroccan lattice window falling on a smooth warm sandstone wall behind. Photorealistic, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, crisp product detail, natural colour grading, calm minimal composition with space around the products, no people, no watermark.

hero_1R.prompt: Beauty editorial close-up portrait. A Moroccan woman in her late twenties with sun-kissed olive skin, natural freckles and dark wavy hair loosely pulled back, eyes softly closed, fingertips resting lightly on her cheek; a single glossy drop of golden argan oil glistens on her cheekbone; luminous healthy skin with real texture and pores, no heavy makeup. Warm low golden-hour sunlight from the left, the soft shadow of a carved lattice window across the warm sandstone-beige background. Her face fills the upper two thirds of the frame; the lower third is darker and quiet. Photorealistic, 100mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, natural colour grading, no text, no watermark.

hero_2L.prompt: Beauty editorial portrait. A radiant woman in her late fifties with short silver hair and warm light-brown skin with natural fine lines, calm confident expression, looking slightly off camera, fingertips touching her jawline; her skin looks deeply nourished and luminous, minimal makeup, simple ivory linen top. Soft diffused morning light, background of pale warm plaster wall with a gentle gradient and the faint shadow of an arch. Face and shoulders in the upper two thirds; the lower third quiet and slightly darker. Photorealistic, 85mm portrait lens, real skin texture, natural colour, no text, no watermark.

hero_3R.prompt: Sun-care beauty editorial portrait. A young woman with deep brown skin and short natural coils, wearing a simple white linen shirt, face tilted up toward strong Moroccan midday sun, eyes closed, a fresh translucent sheen of sunscreen on her cheekbones and nose; crisp graphic shadows of palm fronds fall across her face and shoulder; background warm ochre sandstone wall. Face in the upper two thirds; the lower third in soft shade. Photorealistic, 85mm lens, real skin texture, rich natural colour, no text, no watermark.
